name: Fat Sheep Farm & Cabins
description: Five private cabins on a working farm in Hartland, with hill views, farm activities and family stays.
capacityDetails: Five cabins; occupancy varies by cabin. Sunrise has a queen bedroom and a living-room futon; no explicit maximum on the checked page.
kidsDetails: Children welcome; adult supervision required on the working farm. Sunrise page says children aged two and under stay free.
petsDetails: Dogs only in Sunrise, Ascutney and Lull Brook cabins, on the reservation and leashed. Sunrise pet cleaning fee: $30/night per pet.
priceDetails: Rates vary by date and cabin. Sunrise page lists a $55 one-time cleaning fee, $30/night for additional guests beyond two, and typical two-night weekend/three-night holiday minimums.

address.notes: Official site explicitly says to use Windsor for mailing, rather than Hartland. Physical location is Hartland.

sourceDetails.Notes: Small working-farm operator, not an aggregator. Separate cabins need unit-specific policies and capacity. Genuine photo set shows Sunrise Cabin.
